message: Hey Jane, I heard about the 'Eldritch Enthusiasts' community from our chat the other day. Can you tell me more about it? Who's in it?
Jane, I just wanted to say thank you again for being there for me after my breakup. The support from our 'Eldritch Enthusiasts' group has been a lifesaver.
Don't forget our virtual meet-up for the 'Arcane Revelations' release is this Saturday at 8 PM UTC! Can't wait to see you all there!
Has anyone else noticed the hidden runes in chapter 5 of 'Arcane Revelations'? I think they might be a clue for the next book!
I'm organizing a cosplay contest for our community. Interested folks, please DM me!
Just finished reading 'Arcane Revelations' and OMG the ending blew my mind! No spoilers, but we need to discuss this ASAP!
Reminder: Book club discussion for 'Arcane Revelations' tomorrow at 7 PM. Make sure to have your notes ready!
Can anyone lend me their 'Chronicles of the Arcane' box set for the weekend? I promise to take good care of it!
I'm feeling a bit better today. Thanks for checking in, Jane. This group is the best.
Jane, I saw a 'Chronicles of the Arcane' poster in your cubicle. Is it any good? Worth getting into?
